modern: Get into the habit of paying careful attention to what is said by another, and as far as possible, get inside the speaker’s mind.
original: Accustom thyself to attend carefully to what is said by another, and as much as it is possible, be in the speaker’s mind.
notification: Get into the habit of paying careful attention to what is said by another, and as far as possible, get inside the speaker’s mind.
notification_original: Accustom thyself to attend carefully to what is said by another, and as much as it is possible, be in the speaker’s mind.

explained.summary: Make a habit of listening closely to what other people say, and as far as you can, getting inside their heads to understand what they really mean and why they’re saying it.
explained.today: In a meeting, that might mean actually hearing the objection instead of planning your reply. In a disagreement at home, it might mean asking what’s really bothering the other person before you defend yourself.
